data.name: Aadila
data.gender_notes: Aadila is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿādila (عادلة), the feminine active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l (justice). Feminine counterpart of ʿĀdil. Aadila therefore means “Just; fair; equitable (feminine)”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿādila 'just, fair'; feminine of ʿĀdil.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadila expresses “Just and Fair”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿādila (عادلة), the feminine active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l (justice). Feminine counterpart of ʿĀdil.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadila total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

faq.q: Is Aadila the feminine form of Aadil?
faq.a: Yes. Aadila (عادلة) is the feminine active participle of the same Arabic root ʿ-d-l, meaning 'just, fair', the counterpart of the male name Aadil.

faq.q: What does the name Aadila mean?
Where does the name Aadila come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadila?
faq.a: The root of Aadila is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadila written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadila is written عادلة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadila a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadila is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aadila appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadila is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadila verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just; fair; equitable (feminine)” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿādila 'just, fair'; feminine of ʿĀdil..
